cloudpulse_saas.core_technology: Plantar pressure eBPF telemetrys combined with real-time musculoskeletal Digital Twin modeling.

dev_tier.description: Remote patient monitoring setup and device provisioning (billed once).

growth_tier.description: Remote patient monitoring transmission of data, minimum 16 days of data per month.

starter_tier.description: Remote monitoring transmission of data, 2-15 days of data per month.

enterprise_tier.description: Remote patient monitoring clinical management, minimum 20 minutes of review per month.

pro_tier.description: Remote patient monitoring clinical management, first 10 minutes of review per month.

cloudpulse_saas.value_proposition: Clinicians earn CPT-billable remote patient monitoring revenue while showing patients real-time gait progression data to increase clinical retention.
cloudpulse_saas.pitch_anchor: 16 patients × $99/mo = ~$1,584 MRR per clinician at near-zero marginal cost.

synthetix_ai.core_technology: Markerless biomechanics and injury risk prediction via standard 2D video feeds (computer vision AI).

synthetix_ai.pitch_anchor: Synthetix Trajectory Tracer biomechanical monitoring caught the warning pattern in slow motion before the tissue broke.
